name: San Juan de la Nava (Spain)
description: Purple field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Juan de la Nava (a bull and a column on green).
history: The flag was approved officially on 24 October 2013 together with an earlier version of the arms, whose definitive model was approved on 3 May 2016 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 83 of 3 May 2016); the flag is described as a horizontal cloth of purple colour.

features.role: San Juan de la Nava arms — bull and column
